statement.text: (Exercise in [BGS85, p.2]) Take a closed surface S of genus ≥2. Let V = S × S and let Σ ⊂V denote the diagonal. Let ˜V be a nontrivially ramified finite cover of V along Σ. Then ˜V has a natural piecewise hyperbolic CAT(0) metric. Show that ˜V admits no C2-smooth Riemannian metric with curvature K ≤0.

title: Questions in Geometric Group Theory — Q 2.5
